description: Error-handling workflow for product-video-main (v2). Attached as the error workflow of the main workflow. Handles unexpected node crashes: classifies retryable vs permanent and emits a structured log entry. Expected job outcomes (COMPLETED / FAILED / WAITING_FOR_REVIEW / timeout) are already returned to the caller by the main workflow's Respond nodes — this workflow only fires on unexpected execution errors. Never loops back into the main workflow.
name: product-video-errors

nodes.name: error-trigger
nodes.notes: Receives the failed execution context: workflow name, node, and error message.

nodes.name: classify-error
nodes.notes: Classify as retryable (429, 5xx, timeouts, provider overload, network) vs permanent (auth, validation, bad secret). Retryable → safe to re-POST the webhook with the same idempotencyKey (backend dedupes). Permanent → fix input/config first.

nodes.name: log-error
nodes.notes: Structured error record. Wire this to your own alert channel (email/Telegram/webhook) if you want push notifications — intentionally left as a Code node so no fake endpoint is called.

safety: No infinite loops: error workflow never triggers itself or the main workflow.
Secrets only in n8n env / credential store, never in node parameters.
Idempotent retries via idempotencyKey on POST /api/v1/jobs.
